_comment: Version-pinned upstream licence material for shipped components whose
own artifact carries none. A missing embedded file does not remove the
obligation, so the material is obtained from upstream, pinned to the
exact release, and checksummed - not inferred from an SPDX identifier.
Read by scripts/generate-third-party-notices.py. Its --check fails if a
shipped component's required material is satisfied by neither its own

shared_by_licence._comment: Licence -> the shared text that discharges it for ANY shipped component electing that licence and carrying no material of its own. Rule-based rather than a per-component list, because Apache-2.0 alone covers 38 components and enumerating them would drift the moment a dependency changes.

Apache-2.0.txt.provenance: Canonical Apache License 2.0 text, as published by the Apache Software Foundation. Identical to the copy at LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt, which this project itself released 1.0.0 under.
Apache-2.0.txt.satisfies: Apache-2.0 section 4(a): recipients must be given a copy of the License.

EPL-2.0.txt.provenance: Canonical Eclipse Public License 2.0 text, captured by cyclonedx-maven-plugin with includeLicenseText=true during the Phase 1 licensing review. Sections 3.1 (including 3.1(a)) and 3.3 were verified word-for-word against the Eclipse Foundation's own published text at https://www.eclipse.org/org/documents/epl-2.0/EPL-2.0.txt on 2026-10-10.
EPL-2.0.txt.satisfies: EPL-2.0 section 3.2(b) (a copy of the Agreement accompanies the Program) and supports the section 3.1(a) statement in SOURCE-AVAILABILITY.md.

MIT-modelcontextprotocol-java-sdk-2.0.0..provenance: github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk, file LICENSE, read at the commit the v2.0.0 tag resolves to. The annotated tag object 7fcb504ce1d7d0898fbfc341d0b5389a7a9623ff was dereferenced to commit f56d038409473210c59d6eddef09c4b5cd36042b, which matches the commit the 2026-10-10 review identified for the v2.0.0 release. Fetched via the GitHub API on 2026-10-10, not from the default branch.
MIT-modelcontextprotocol-java-sdk-2.0.0..copyright: Copyright (c) 2025 the original author or authors.
MIT-modelcontextprotocol-java-sdk-2.0.0..copyright_note: Reproduced exactly as upstream writes it. No holder name was substituted or guessed.
MIT-modelcontextprotocol-java-sdk-2.0.0..satisfies: MIT: the copyright notice and the permission notice must be included.
MIT-modelcontextprotocol-java-sdk-2.0.0..covers_note: One LICENSE governs all three artifacts: they are modules of a single upstream repository released together under the v2.0.0 tag.

MIT-jtokkit-1.1.0.txt.provenance: github.com/knuddelsgmbh/jtokkit, file LICENSE, read at the commit tag 1.1.0 resolves to: 4c98bebbbc285de0432abca6b2c8f55f2f51133a. Fetched via the GitHub API on 2026-10-10.
MIT-jtokkit-1.1.0.txt.satisfies: MIT: the copyright notice and the permission notice must be included.

BSD-3-Clause-antlr4-4.13.1.txt.provenance: github.com/antlr/antlr4, file LICENSE.txt, read at the commit tag 4.13.1 resolves to: 7ed420ff2c78d62883875c442d75f32e73bc86c8. Fetched via the GitHub API on 2026-10-10.

BSD-3-Clause-antlr4-4.13.1.txt.satisfies: BSD-3-Clause: binary redistribution must reproduce the copyright notice, the list of conditions and the disclaimer. All three are in this file.

no_material_required._comment: Licences that impose no attribution or licence-delivery condition on binary redistribution. Listed explicitly so that 'nothing was collected' is a recorded finding rather than an omission.
no_material_required.org.reactivestreams:reactive-streams:1.0: MIT-0 removes MIT's attribution requirement entirely; nothing is required.

spring-boot-jarmode-tools-4.1.1.jar.provenance: Shipped but absent from the SBOM, because spring-boot-maven-plugin's repackage goal inserts it rather than resolving it as a project dependency, so cyclonedx (which reads the dependency graph) never sees it. It is a Spring Boot module from the same release as every other spring-boot-* artifact here, published by VMware under Apache-2.0, and its jar carries META-INF/NOTICE.txt and META-INF/LICENSE.txt, both reproduced in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Its provenance is therefore established from the artifact, not from the SBOM.
